note:
Coverage. The paper prints 23 exhibits: 14 numbered figures and 9 numbered tables. Twenty-one of them own a measured region; Tables 4 and 5 print side by side above every detected box on p15, so they are declared here as unboxed and carry no item. The census claims 27 items over 36 measured regions with 9 exclusions, and no exhibit is solo on a page. Page 1 is a cover in letter format (612x792 pt) while pages 2-23 are 595.5x842, so the document carries two page geometries and any area fraction on page 1 is computed against the cover's own frame. 

Region count is not exhibit count. The eight boxes on p9 are two exhibits: each four-panel strip is a column of separate bitmaps, so the detector sees four regions per figure, and the census claims them as panel items rather than collapsing them. Four more regions are duplicate detections of an exhibit already claimed - p10's r3 and r4 are the raster plot layer inside Figure 3's vector axis box, p15's r3 sits over Figure 9 at IoU 0.93, and p18's r3 is nested 96 per cent inside Figure 13's frame. The last five exclusions are raster strips that are not exhibits at all: two Summary paragraphs on p1, the utility-function equations (2)(3)(4) on p13, equation (5) on p14, the prose plus equation (6) on p16, and the Shapley equations (7)(8) on p20. 

Apparatus. Every one of those raster strips is invisible to the text layer: p1 jumps from 'average values of other cities.' to 'After that, we use the ARIMA model', losing both Summary paragraphs, and p16 and p20 lose whole equations. Two figures print with completely empty plot areas - Figure 4 on p10 and Figure 9 on p15 both show frame, gridlines and axis titles over 0.000 per cent data ink - while the prose ranks four states from Figure 9. Figure 14 repeats Figure 13's caption verbatim though the two artworks share nothing but plot chrome. The x tick labels of Figures 3, 4 and 9 print as unreadable glyph clusters and the fuel category is misspelt 'PATROLEUM' in all eight strip panels. Table 8 glues wind and solar into single row labels, so its four prices are never attached to a technology, and Table 9's two rows both fail to foot: shares sum to 0.998 against a printed 1, money to 348.6 against a printed 343.85. 

What the custody buys. Read as a set, the exhibits keep three habits: captions below for figures and above for tables without exception; one caption per composite, printed outside the panels; and a reading sentence after the citation that converts the picture into a ranking. Everything the paper knows about how to place an exhibit comes from that trio, and nothing in it depends on the figure family.
rules: Twenty figure boxes caption BELOW the artwork and seven table boxes caption ABOVE it: the side is decided by exhibit kind, with no exception in either direction [caption.position].
Two four-panel strips print ONE caption for four panels and place it once, centred under the whole row, so the caption belongs to the strip and every panel item inherits it [geometry.panel_count].

Panel order inside a strip runs x-ascending (AZ, CA, NM, TX) while the box indices run AZ, CA, NM, TX as r2, r1, r3, r4 - the census orders panels by geometry, never by region index [geometry.panel_layout].
The legend takes the upper-right corner inside the frame in ten boxes and the upper-left in exactly one, the only stacked bar in the paper [geometry.legend].

Nine figures carry no legend at all, and in five of them the absence is the defect: four-series Figure 13, the three-ink Figure 12, the unlabelled guides of Figure 14, and the two empty plot areas [geometry.legend].
No figure carries a colourbar and no figure is three-dimensional; both devices stay unused across all fourteen [geometry.colorbar] [geometry.three_d].
The only artwork with no printed numbers is the one schematic; every chart that plots a series also prints ticks and tick labels [geometry.printed_numbers].
No artwork prints values on its marks, so every number a reader needs is in a grid rather than on a bar [geometry.data_labels].
The two strips repeat frame, scale, legend and axis title in each panel instead of declaring shared axes [geometry.shared_axes].

Rule style alternates: the two early definition grids and the two late data grids are horizontals only, while the three middle result grids each carry an internal full-height vertical [table.rule_style].
Two grids span the full measure (1.00 and 0.97) and five sit between 0.49 and 0.81 of it; nothing is column-narrow [table.width].
Only Table 2 puts its unit in the header; Tables 8 and 9 put the unit inside the stub cell and the other four print no unit at all [table.units_in_header].

Two grids are decimal-aligned - Table 3 and the two-row state grid of Table 7 - and five are centred, which is why negative coefficients in Table 6 do not line up on the point [table.decimal_aligned].

The paper never uses zebra shading, merged cells, a diagonal header, a landscape grid or a continued table, though its spanner-widths invite all five [table.zebra] [table.merged_cells] [table.diagonal_header] [table.orientation] [table.continued].
Header rows are one on every grid except Table 3, where two stacked tabulars each contribute their own header row [table.header_rows].
Every grid puts one text stub against three to five numeric columns; the only all-text grid is the symbol glossary [table.numeric_cols] [table.text_cols].
Grid size runs 3 rows by 5 columns up to 9 rows by 2 columns; the glossary's nine rows make it the tallest table in the paper [table.rows] [table.cols].

Only three section kinds host an exhibit - symbols for the notation glossary, model for the method apparatus, result for everything measured; the abstract, the assumptions and the evaluation section carry none [place.section_kind].

All fourteen figures and six of the nine tables are cited by number; the notation glossary is the only table the prose never names, reached instead by 'Here are the notations and their meanings in our paper:' [mention.first_page].

Lead sentences take three shapes and the shape decides the word order: 'In Figure 1, we present' (figure first), 'Figure 2 shows' (figure as subject), 'as shown in Figure 7' (figure last) [mention.lead_pattern].

Two exhibits are pointed at from inside a subordinate clause while the sentence is still building - 'according to Figure 11' and 'using the data in Table 2' - rather than from a sentence of their own [mention.lead_pattern].

Every cited figure is followed within one sentence by a reading sentence, and the reading regularly outruns the artwork: four states are ranked from a figure with no data ink [mention.read_sentences].
Two exhibits are cited twice (Figures 1/3 and 9) and one only inside a joined spelling, 'Figure9'; the count field keeps the printed occurrences, not the intended ones [mention.count].
A lead of one page occurs twice (Figure 3, Table 6) and no lead exceeds it; the rest are cited on their own page [mention.lead_pages].
Caption spellings are recorded as printed, including the joined 'Figure9' that the p15 sentence uses for the second of its two figures [mention.style].

Captions are noun phrases: none concludes, none states a condition, none prints a unit, and none is written in the active voice [caption.concludes] [caption.conditions] [caption.units] [caption.voice].
Only one caption names a variable symbol - Figure 12's CAr - and the rest name a quantity in words, which is why the two forecast figures end up with identical captions [caption.variables].
Captions run four to eight words each, one sentence every time, always with the colon inside the number line [caption.words] [caption.sentences] [caption.numbering].
Exhibits cluster in the top and middle thirds of their pages and none is given a page of its own: no exhibit is solo [place.page_zone] [place.solo_page].
A region's area runs from 0.02 of the page for a strip panel to 0.18 for the notation glossary; the paper never prints a page-sized exhibit [place.area_frac].

Panel boxes are claimed as items with the parent strip named in panel_of, so the family aggregate counts eight bar rows for the two four-panel strips rather than two [geometry.family] [geometry.panel_count].

tables.note: The symbol glossary, and the widest grid in the paper at 1.00 of the measure. Three horizontal rules - top, under the header, foot - and not one vertical stroke anywhere in the body, so the two 2-line meanings wrap instead of colliding.
